ratings_why.fun: Every turn asks how much to pay, carry or Skim, and the growth climbs from Chimney Jackdaw seeds to Corbie and Don paydays; nine Debt rules keep it from going higher.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: one IOU pile that gates Tier up and is read three opposite ways (carry, clear, Skim) is a tempo-versus-power tension no Battlegrounds tribe or today's tribe has.

verdict_why: v2 cleared the readability and Uncle Jack problems; what is left is heat for the owner to balance, not a fix.

points.text: The early curve is good: Hawthorn Fledgling's optional Owe 2 costs you the turn-2 Tier up, a real tempo-for-stats choice on turn 1.

Rookery Don with Sorrow and Joy and three Skims gives about +14/+14 to each other unit a win, well past the Tier 6 top. It is win-more rather than self-feeding, since Skim size is fixed, so leave it hot and let the owner tune.
Thorn Nest Fence with Tick-Book Magpie is a free clear engine: credit-buy a unit, sell it, clear its tier in old Debt for a net gain. Strong and fun; it is the collection build's real motor.
Golden Uncle Jack goes Tier 4 to 6 in one turn on about 24 Debt, which then feeds Arne. The compounding interest and Bill due are the counterplay, so this reads as a great high roll.
Seven's exactly-7 puzzle works because End of Turn Owes from Thought and Oast Usurer land before combat; a preview of Start of Combat Debt would make it a joy rather than a sum.

standouts.why: Uncle Jack turns the tier lock into a gamble: rush now, owe big, and pray you win.
Rookery Don makes winning pay twice and gives the Skim build a capstone worth reaching.
Seven is a real puzzle capstone that fits the rhyme and the carry build.

weakest.why: Belfry Jackdaw is plain gold for holding any Debt; it does the expected thing and little else.
Wassail Bowl-Bearer is a capped Attack-only buffer with no twist on the Debt pile.
Arne is a straight per-Debt team buff that overlaps Orchard Heavy and Seven's carry role.

flags.note: With Sorrow and Joy (golden triples it) the permanent gain per win runs well past the Tier 6 top band.
At 30 Debt Arne gives about 10 bodies in a fight; golden Uncle Jack reaches that Debt fast.
Golden Uncle Jack's two credit Tier ups a turn may make him the best tempo card in any lobby.
